# Select Song From Apple Music

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Allows you to select a song from Apple Music.

## Syntax

~~~~text
selectSong(multiple: <#Boolean (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
selectSong(multiple: false)
~~~~
